t: Universal co-polymer sealant for a wide range of sealing and weatherproofing applications. Can be used in building, roofing and ductwork applications and applied in wet weather and damp conditions. Provides excellent adhesion to most surfaces such as glass, aluminium, lead and zinc. Ideal for emergency repairs in wet weather conditions.
